name: delivery-check-material-freshness
title: Force stale delivery-check when reviewed material changes
description: A delivery-check pass can remain visible after the source material it reviewed changes. This is a correctness issue in DONE readiness: delivery evidence must not keep passing over different material. Keep the fix narrow to delivery-check binding and gate/readiness classification, without changing local scheduling or weakening delivery reviewer role separation.
source: user-requested baseline item 5 follow-up after B-4c48
